description: Reference snapshot of the GitHub label taxonomy actually in use on ACFHarbinger/WSmart-Route (`gh label list`), kept here so the label set has one canonical, human-browsable home. Unlike Image-Toolkit's git/config/, this is not consumed by any automation script -- WSmart-Route's multi-agent workflow runs on the .agent/bus/ + AGENTS.md convention (see AGENTS.md), not a GraphQL sync bot. Regenerate by hand with `gh label list --limit 50` when labels change.
